title: CLUSTER: Derivative-free optimization of smooth functions with parameter-change costs
summary: We introduce the CLUSTER algorithm (\textbf{c}oordinate-\textbf{l}evel \textbf{u}pdate \textbf{s}trategy for \textbf{t}rust-region step \textbf{e}valuation \textbf{r}efinement) for local derivative-free optimization problems where there is a cost to changing each parameter (or clusters of parameters). For example, this type of cost model is appropriate for optimizing robot-controlled laboratory experiments, in which a robot may incur a separate motion for each parameter cluster to be adjusted.
